ablation: personnel axis: identical model with vs without the Week 10 unavailability floor
method: identical fits, one with the personnel axis folded into the ratings and one without, on chronological holdouts; bootstrap over fixtures (4000 draws, seed 20261115)
interpretation: n is the finding. With two fixtures the interval is uninformative, which is precisely why a fixed 'points per missing starter' penalty may not replace the measurement

ablation: home-field axis: the same fit used with the estimated home intercept and with it forced to zero
method: identical ridge fit, prediction made with the estimated home intercept and with it forced to zero; paired bootstrap over graded fixtures (2000 draws, seed frozen in the pre-registration)
interpretation: the estimated home effect is negative this season, so an assumed home advantage is not a neutral prior - it pushes every line the wrong way
